scenario_user_message: Should I build a portfolio project first, or grind interview questions first?

finalMessages.content: Should I build a portfolio project first, or grind interview questions first?

content.text:
Good question, but let me split it, because half of it isn't mine to answer.

The portfolio half — whether to build a project, what kind, how it proves AIPM ability — belongs to your "Portfolio" sibling node. I won't go deep on that here.

What I can speak to is the sequencing question, and from the interview-prep side the answer is: a portfolio project isn't really a competing alternative to interview prep — it's often the raw material for it. AIPM interviews lean heavily on "tell me about a time you..." and product-sense/case questions. If you don't have a project or real experience to draw on, you'll be grinding answers with nothing concrete to anchor them.

So the more useful framing than "which first" is: the project gives you stories and judgment; interview prep is learning to extract and present them under the specific formats AIPM loops use.

Before I push further — do you already have any AI-adjacent work or project to talk about, or are you starting from zero? That changes the answer a lot.

stop_reason: end_turn
